package.description: Just-in-time Entra and Azure PIM role activation from the terminal

en-US.description: Just-in-time Entra and Azure PIM role activation from the terminal
en-US.longDescription:
The command-line counterpart of the Elevate desktop apps for Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity
Management. Sign in with one or more Entra accounts, list the Entra directory roles, Azure resource
roles and PIM-for-Groups memberships you are eligible for across tenants, activate them with a
duration and reason, extend, deactivate or cancel, run saved profiles, decide approvals, and get
JSON output and exit codes for scripts. Sign in with your own app registration through the
browser or a device code, or with the Azure CLI or Azure PowerShell app for Azure resource roles.
en-US.name: Elevate CLI
